Analysis of the scandal cluster reveals a complex web of entities and investigations. The cluster includes 214 active investigations, indicating a significant level of scrutiny. Key actors include Justin Trudeau, Marco Mendicino, and Anthony Housefather, who have been implicated in various scandals. The cluster also includes entities such as Bill C-14 (MAID Act 2016) and Bill C-7 (MAID Expansion 2021), which have been the subject of controversy.

Connections to other scandals can be drawn to the SNC-Lavalin Affair (2019) and the Emergencies Act Invocation (2022), both of which involved Justin Trudeau. The ArriveCAN Scandal (2021) and the Winnipeg Lab Security Breach (2022) also share connections to the cluster. The Nijjar Assassination (June 2023) and the NSICOP Foreign Interference Report (2024) indicate ongoing investigations into national security and intelligence matters. The Housing Affordability Crisis (ongoing) and the Phoenix Pay System Scandal (2016-2018) demonstrate broader systemic issues in government administration.
